d: In his first address after being released from Tihar Jail, activist and Cockroach Janta Party spokesperson Saurav Das thanked citizens and the youth for their continued support. Das asserted that he and Ashutosh were imprisoned merely for unfurling the national flag and chanting patriotic slogans. Strongly denying allegations of foreign funding reiterated by Union Minister Jitendra Singh, he stated that authorities are attempting to malign the youth movement through baseless claims while ignoring key issues such as mass unemployment, paper leaks, and inflation.
